53474-prejudices-third-series.description: A book by H. L. Mencken. e and way points—anywhere to escape the great curses and atrocities that make life intolerable for them at home. Let me say at once that I find little to cavil at in their basic complaints. In more than one direction, indeed, I probably go a great deal further than even the Young Intellectuals.

67947-a-handy-guide-for-beggars-especial.title: A Handy Guide For Beggars Especially Those Of The Poetic Fra
67947-a-handy-guide-for-beggars-especial.creator: Unknown
67947-a-handy-guide-for-beggars-especial.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. is book is dedicated to all the children of Don Quixote who see giants where most folks see windmills: those Galahads dear to Christ and those virgin sisters of Joan of Arc who serve the lepers on their knees and march in shabby armor against the proud, who look into the lightning with the eyes of the mountain cat.

arxiv-1601-01399.title: An adaptive gradient method for computing generalized tensor eigenpairs
arxiv-1601-01399.creator: Gaohang Yu, Zefeng Yu, Yi Xu, Yisheng Song
arxiv-1601-01399.description: Abstract High order tensor arises more and more often in signal processing, data analysis, higher-order statistics, as well as imaging sciences. In this paper, an adaptive gradient (AG) method is presented for generalized tensor eigenpairs. Global convergence and linear convergence rate are established under some suitable conditions. Numerical results are reported to illustrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

arxiv-1807-00626.title: An isoperimetric inequality for Hamming balls and local expansion in hypercubes
arxiv-1807-00626.creator: Zilin Jiang, Amir Yehudayoff
arxiv-1807-00626.description: Abstract We prove a vertex isoperimetric inequality for the n n -dimensional Hamming ball ℬ n ​ ( R ) \mathcal{B}_{n}(R) of radius R R . The isoperimetric inequality is sharp up to a constant factor for sets that are comparable to ℬ n ​ ( R ) \mathcal{B}_{n}(R) in size.

arxiv-2303-12704.title: AptSim2Real: Approximately-Paired Sim-to-Real Image Translation
arxiv-2303-12704.creator: Charles Y Zhang University of Waterloo, Canada cy9zhang@uwaterloo.ca Ashish Shrivastava Cruise LLC, United States, ashish.shrivastava@getcruise.com
arxiv-2303-12704.description: Abstract Advancements in graphics technology has increased the use of simulated data for training machine learning models. However, the simulated data often differs from real-world data, creating a distribution gap that can decrease the efficacy of models trained on simulation data in real-world applications.

arxiv-2502-06809.title: Neurons Speak in Ranges: Breaking Free from Discrete Neuronal Attribution
arxiv-2502-06809.creator: Muhammad Umair Haider muhammadumairhaider@uky.edu, Hammad Rizwan hammad.rizwan@dal.ca, Hassan Sajjad, Peizhong Ju, A.B. Siddique
arxiv-2502-06809.description: Abstract Pervasive polysemanticity in large language models (LLMs) undermines discrete neuron–concept attribution, posing a significant challenge for model interpretation and control. We systematically analyze both encoder and decoder-based LLMs across diverse datasets, and observe that even highly salient neurons for specific semantic concepts consistently exhibit polysemantic behavior.

arxiv-2601-15049.title: Deep Leakage with Generative Flow Matching Denoiser
arxiv-2601-15049.creator: Isaac Baglin, Xiatian Zhu, Simon Hadfield
arxiv-2601-15049.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for decentralized model training, yet it remains vulnerable to deep leakage (DL) attacks that reconstruct private client data from shared model updates. While prior DL methods have demonstrated varying levels of success, they often suffer from instability, limited fidelity, or poor robustness under realistic FL settings.

pmc-10520874.title: Double-layer adhesives for preventing anastomotic leakage and reducing post-surgical adhesion
pmc-10520874.creator: Sung Il Kang, Hyun Ho Shin, Da Han Hyun, Ghilsuk Yoon, Jun Seok Park, Ji Hyun Ryu
pmc-10520874.description: Preventing anastomotic leakage (AL) and postoperative adhesions after gastrointestinal surgery is crucial for ensuring a favorable surgical prognosis. However, AL prevention using tissue adhesives can unintentionally lead to undesirable adhesion formation, while anti-adhesive agents may interfere with wound healing and contribute to AL.

pmc-10679767.title: High acceptability, convenience and reduced carbon emissions of tele-neurology outpatient services at a regional referral centre in Kenya
pmc-10679767.creator: Fazal Abdulaziz Yakub, Jasmit Shah, Dilraj Singh Sokhi
pmc-10679767.description: BackgroundThere is severe shortage of neurologists in sub-Saharan Africa. Tele-neurology consultations (TNC) can bridge this service gap, but there is very little published evidence on TNC in our setting, which we addressed through our study.MethodsWe prospectively enrolled patients at our neurology outpatients from October 2020 to October 2021. We administered a post-TNC questionnaire which captured satisfaction/acceptability using Likert scales.

pmc-11500176.title: Alterations of regional brain activity and corresponding brain circuits in drug-naïve adolescents with nonsuicidal self-injury
pmc-11500176.creator: Kaike Liao, Rui Yu, Yuwei Chen, Xinyue Chen, Xinyan Wu, Xiaohua Huang, Nian Liu
pmc-11500176.description: Nonsuicidal self-injury (NSSI) is one of the major public health problems endangering adolescents. However, the neural mechanisms of NSSI is still unclear. The purpose of this study was to explore regional brain activity and corresponding brain circuits in drug-naïve adolescents with NSSI using amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF) combined with functional connectivity (FC) analysis.

pmc-11538243.title: Therapeutic potential of hyaluronic acid hydrogel combined with bone marrow stem cells-conditioned medium on arthritic rats’ TMJs
pmc-11538243.creator: Mai M. Assi, Mohammed E. Grawish, Heba Mahmoud Elsabaa, Mohamad E. Helal, Samah K. Ezzat
pmc-11538243.description: Conditioned media (CM) is derived from mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) culture and contains biologically active components. CM is easy to handle and reduces inflammation while repairing injured joints. Combination therapy of the CM with cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) could ameliorate the beneficial effect of HA in treating degenerative changes of articulating surfaces associated with arthritic rats’ temporomandibular joints (TMJs).

pmc-11677724.title: Preclinical Study of a Dual-Target Molecular Probe Labeled with 68Ga Targeting SSTR2 and FAP
pmc-11677724.creator: Huanhuan Liu, Xiaojun Zhang, Yue Pan, Jingfeng Zhang, Hui Wen, Cong Zhang, Xiaodan Xu, Guangyu Ma, Ruimin Wang, Jinming Zhang
pmc-11677724.description: Objective: Currently, 68Ga-labeled somatostatin analogs (SSAs) are the most commonly used imaging agents for patients with neuroendocrine tumors (NETs) in clinical practice, demonstrating good results in tumor diagnosis. For applications in peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (PRRT), targeted drugs should have high tumor uptake and prolonged tumor retention time.

pmc-11693007.title: CARING FOR ONE, TWO, OR THREE GENERATIONS? PREVALENCE OF VARIOUS CAREGIVING ROLES AND CAREGIVER CHARACTERISTICS
pmc-11693007.creator: Hua Zan, Loriena Yancura, Melissa Barnett
pmc-11693007.description: With increasing diversification in household composition and living arrangements over recent decades, the roles of family caregivers have become more complex, sometimes requiring individuals to assume multiple caregiving responsibilities such as caring for both grandchildren and older parents. While caregiving can be a rewarding experience, it can negatively affect caregiver well-being, especially for those providing high-intensity care.

pmc-11713400.title: Genome‐Wide Associations of Cognitive Domains and their Correlation with Polygenic Risk Scores for Antidepressant Response in Late‐Life Depression
pmc-11713400.creator: Samar Elsheikh, Victoria Marshe, Malgorzata Maciukiewicz, Farhana Islam, Xiaoyu Men, Vanessa SM Gonçalves, Daniel Felsky, James L Kennedy, Benoit H Mulsant, Charles F Reynolds, Eric J Lenze, Daniel Mueller
pmc-11713400.description: BackgroundLate‐life depression (LLD) often coincides with cognitive decline, impacting antidepressant treatment outcomes. Investigating the genetic profile of cognitive function and its association with antidepressant response in individuals with LLD is crucial.MethodIn the Incomplete Response in Late‐Life Depression: Getting to Remission (IRL‐GRey) study, 307 older adults with major depressive disorder underwent 12‐week venlafaxine treatment.

pmc-12420509.title: Addressing Mental Health Needs After a Public Health Crisis in Southern Switzerland: Stakeholders’ Perspectives
pmc-12420509.creator: Camilla Sculco, Manuela Barreca, Marco Meneguzzo, Emiliano Albanese
pmc-12420509.description: ObjectivesThis paper examines a stakeholder engagement initiative to develop public health recommendations for addressing mental health gaps after the COVID-19 pandemic in southern Switzerland. It explores local healthcare professionals’ experiences with the pandemic’s impact on mental health and service use.MethodsWe used a stakeholder dialogue methodology based on participatory research.

pmc-12512446.title: Application of visualization three-dimensional medical imaging technology based on mobile platform in surgery of giant thyroid tumors: a case report
pmc-12512446.creator: Zhen Wu, Hailin Sun, Zhao Li, Shen Chen, Lin Han, Yongkui Wang, Wenchao Duan, Wei Zhang
pmc-12512446.description: BackgroundSurgical treatment for giant thyroid tumors is complex and carries a high risk of complications. Visualization of the tumor shape and its associations with the surrounding tissue are difficult with two-dimensional imaging techniques. It is thus important to explore more effective approaches for preoperative evaluation and surgical assistance.

pmc-12607089.title: Prevalence of pressure ulcer and associated factors in Ethiopia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12607089.creator: Bekalu Mekonen Belay, Yeshiambaw Eshetie, Masresha Kassaw Ewunetu, Yirgalem Abere, Mengistu Ewunetu, Zemenu Addis Alem, Fetene Nigussie Tarekegn, Bantalem Tilaye Atinafu
pmc-12607089.description: BackgroundPressure ulcers remain common in both hospitals and in the community settings, leading to chronic wounds that are difficult to treat.ObjectiveThis study aims to assess the prevalence of pressure ulcer and associated factors in Ethiopia.MethodsThis review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines.

pmc-13146446.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A471 DETECTION OF CARDIAC THROMBI BY CT IN PATIENTS WITH TRANSIENT ISCHAEMIC ATTACK
pmc-13146446.creator: Shuyu Guo, Mirre Hilt, Shan Sui Nio, M D Golam Hasnain, Daniel Green, John Fink, Mark Parsons, Carlos Garcia-Esperon, Teddy Wu, Jonathan Coutinho
pmc-13146446.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsCardiac CT integrated into acute stroke imaging protocol detects cardiac thrombi in approximately 6-8% of patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS). We assessed the yield of cardiac CT in patients with transient ischaemic attacks (TIA).MethodsWe compared the data from the AIS of HEARTS collaboration with contemporaneous TIA patients presenting to four hospitals in the Netherlands, Australia, and New Zealand.

pmc-13570612.title: Short-Term Outcomes of an Investigational Hybrid Polymer–Hyaluronic Acid Filler for Nonsurgical Rhinoplasty: An Uncontrolled Pilot Study
pmc-13570612.creator: Hsin-Kai Chen, Hsi-Cheng Liu, Heng-Ju Lin, Donghui Wu
pmc-13570612.description: BackgroundNonsurgical rhinoplasty using hyaluronic acid fillers provides minimally invasive correction of selected nasal contour irregularities. Hybrid formulations incorporating biodegradable polymeric microspheres have been developed to provide immediate volumetric correction together with additional structural support; however, clinical evidence regarding these formulations remains limited.
